En Riverglades (35-45), la Alianza tiene: In Riverglades (35-45), the Alliance has the Brotherhood of the Horse on its side, based at Farholde Keep, and the Horde has the Boulderrock ogre clan, who used to serve the Twilight's Hammer. There's an ogre fighting ring and the Bloodmasters Ring, a challenge arena similar to Nagrand's Ring of Blood, from around level 36.
Fuente: Vídeo de Blizzard, vía <a href=\: Source: Blizzard video, via Wowhead
Son 65 puntos al salir (12 más cuando ll: There are 65 points at launch (12 more when Hardcore arrives). A single character can earn 29, but you can only spend 16 per character, so choose. Gathering professions and Cooking give no points. Points can be reset (it cost 10 gold in the beta; not confirmed for launch).
Recompensas por los puntos que ganas, lo: Rewards for the points you earn, spent or not: at 15, the Replica Ironforge Air Rifle toy; at 25, the Spectral Bear Cub pet; at 40, the Spectral Bear Tabard; at 55, the epic Reins of the Spectral Bear mount. You collect them from Wiley the innkeeper in Ratchet. Without the 12 PvP challenges you stop at 53, without the mount. Seen in the beta: Blizzard hasn't published the list.
Estudio dedicado (Dedicated Study): +1 a: Dedicated Study: +1 to your lowest profession (in the beta, once every 24 hours).
Mazmorra nueva de WoW Forever (entró en: New WoW Forever dungeon (it entered the beta in the October 8 build: "Now available for testing: the new City of Dalaran dungeon"). In Classic, Dalaran was sealed under a violet dome. Wowhead recommends 28-34; Warcraft Tavern lists it as 28-33. Beta notes: the Horde is no longer welcome in open-world Dalaran and gets attacked on sight, but that doesn't affect access to the dungeon; enemies were added outside the entrance. In the latest build, open-world Dalaran has level 55 elite Arcane Sentries, Kirin Tor guards who point you to the inn, trainers and transmogrifier, and battlemasters in the Underbelly (beta data, may change).
Horda: portal en las Ruinas de Lordaeron: Horde: portal in the Ruins of Lordaeron (the open part above Undercity), to the left of that area's entrance; you reach it from Tirisfal Glades, south of Brill. Alliance: long trip (boat to Auberdine, to Menethil, to Southshore; go around Dalaran and swim across Lordamere Lake to Tirisfal); Alliance Skyborne had a Stormwind to Dalaran portal, but in the latest beta build it seems to have been removed (unconfirmed). No key.
Cada profesión tiene tres objetos de cam: Each profession has three camp objects: the first is learned at skill 20 (Cooking's Basic Campfire, at 1) and the best come from blueprints dropped by dungeon bosses. Next to the campfire they give one-hour buffs.
En Forever casi toda la comida da un 5 %: In Forever almost all food gives 5% more experience per kill, on top of stats (seen in the beta). And Cooking is the base of camping: its fire becomes the Basic Campfire, and cooks craft improved campfires that hold 5 to 10 objects.
Hacia el nivel 5 unas misiones te enseña: Around level 5, some quests teach you camping. With Cooking you set up the campfire; everyone else adds one object each. Sit (or craft) for a minute by the fire and you keep the buffs for an hour. Each object has three ranks: the first is learned at skill 20 (Cooking's Basic Campfire, at 1) and each rank includes the previous one. Look for the camp that suits you: with a strength character, the blacksmith's.
Casi todos los platos dan ahora un 5 % m: Almost all dishes now give 5% more experience per kill, on top of stats (seen in the beta).
